notes: Stratified equal samples of actual randomized regional runs; frozen live enemy teams, IVs, seeds, trainers, rewards and organization assignments. Every continued run assumes earlier wins, so recording ends villain events after the first boss. Both sides use public-information policies; versions are specified by playerAI/opponentAI. Mode comparison: same frozen courses and seeds, forbidden enemy gimmick tools removed exactly as in the live store, forbidden shop tools excluded before the rarity draw. Only tera-enabled rules start with one player tera ticket and frozen opponent tickets; consumes actual tera protocol, buys current-price ticket when empty after useful gear/TMs and before consumables, preserving 400 reserve. Own-stat/type team selection, best-BST capture, six-member collection approximation, full recovery per floor, primary-type tera defaults. Current price and shop hash conventions, exact stock sizes, at most 2 vitamins and 1 free reroll/category; consumables carried in a bag and used before attacks, with native rank effects rather than old five-floor buffs; shops every ten floors for 100-floor runs, owned/incompatible tools excluded with unfilled sold-out rarity draws. No future enemy knowledge. Simulated strategies, not human win rates; regional sampling intentionally differs from random population weighting.
